sources.title: DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B model card
sources.evidence: Freshly reopened and directly retrieved October 27. The exact-model section explicitly says Qwen3-8B Base was post-trained on R1-0528 chain-of-thought outputs; the deployment section states architecture is identical to Qwen3-8B. Distillation here trains the named student rather than pruning the full R1 teacher. No structural resizing or modality addition is described; larger-model tool benchmarks remain separate.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint config.json
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved the pinned configuration October 27 and compared it with official Qwen3-8B-Base. All parameter-bearing dimensions match: 36 layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 12288, 32 query/8 KV heads, head dimension 128, vocabulary 151936 and untied embeddings. Only EOS, YaRN scaling and context differ; these add no learned parameter matrices. The DeepSeek configuration retains 131072 maximum positions with 4x YaRN from 32768 original positions.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint safetensors index
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved the pinned index October 27: it still enumerates 399 tensors in two shards and 16,381,470,720 tensor-data bytes, matching the previously verified BF16 header census. No weight shard or header was downloaded again in this re-audit.

sources.title: Official checkpoint shard 1 tensor header
sources.evidence: Bounded HTTP 206 request fetched 262144 bytes, including the 24362-byte header; 211 BF16 learned-weight tensors contain 4,305,089,280 elements. No quantization-scale or buffer tensors.

sources.title: Official checkpoint shard 2 tensor header
sources.evidence: Bounded HTTP 206 request fetched 262144 bytes, including the 21698-byte header; 188 BF16 learned-weight tensors contain 3,885,646,080 elements. Combined complete learned count is 8,190,735,360.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint tokenizer configuration and chat template
sources.evidence: Text chat template handles reasoning delimiters and serializes assistant tool_calls and tool responses; model_max_length is 131072. Template structure alone does not prove tool-use training or capability.

sources.title: DeepSeek checkpoint MIT license
sources.evidence: Distributed release includes the MIT license with DeepSeek copyright; the model card applies MIT to model use.

sources.title: Underlying Qwen3-8B-Base model card
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved October 27. The explicitly named base declares nominal 8.2B total, 6.95B non-embedding parameters and 36 layers. These rounded figures are consistent with the preserved exact checkpoint total; non-embedding size is not substituted for active parameters. The separate Qwen3 report supplies the nominal activated convention. The base card still declares Apache-2.0, distinct from the DeepSeek release MIT license, and 32768 native context.

sources.title: DeepSeek R1-0528 announcement
sources.evidence: Page dated 2025-05-28 expressly names the Qwen3-8B distillation. Tool-calling/API statements identify the full R1-0528 model. Current page does not establish when the 8B-specific text was first published.

sources.title: Official checkpoint repository commit history
sources.evidence: Repository initial commit is 2025-05-29T11:07:47Z; weight upload is 2025-05-29T11:25:11Z; final configuration fix is 2025-05-29T13:13:34Z. Upload timestamps do not alone establish first public release.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint tokenizer vocabulary
sources.evidence: Tokenizer is text-only. Tool delimiter strings used by the template are absent as individual vocabulary/added tokens; this observation neither proves nor disproves learned tool capability.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report - activated-parameter comparison tables
sources.evidence: Read October 27, including Tables 17 and 18. Both explicitly label Qwen3-8B as dense with 8B activated parameters. This is a developer nominal convention, distinct from the precise total and non-embedding counts. Applied through DeepSeek’s explicit identical-architecture and named-base post-training statements, not merely because the model is dense.

sources.title: Official Qwen3-8B Base configuration
sources.evidence: Freshly retrieved October 27 and compared with the pinned DeepSeek configuration. Layer, hidden, intermediate, attention-head, head-dimension and vocabulary values match, as does untied embedding structure. Differences are EOS and context/YaRN settings; no learned-dimension change appears.

sources.title: DeepSeek-R1 revised technical report - later comparison check
sources.evidence: Opened the January 2026 revision October 27 and checked exact 0528/Qwen3 names and activated-parameter tables. The report contains no 0528 or Qwen3 entry; its 37B active disclosure describes full R1/V3. It adds no conflicting count for this student model. Fresh exact-name count searches likewise supplied no developer revision to the explicit Qwen architecture basis.

name.note: Display spelling of the exact DeepSeek-R1-0528-Qwen3-8B checkpoint.

developer.note: DeepSeek publishes the distilled checkpoint; Qwen supplies its base architecture and pretrained model.

family.note: Catalog grouping is supported by R1-0528 reasoning-distillation lineage; architecture is Qwen3.

release_date.note: Month is established; day remains conflicting. Current May 28 announcement names this variant, while exact repository creation and weight uploads are May 29. Do not equate an upload date or the parent-model date with independently established first public availability.

open_weights.note: Public original BF16 checkpoint shards are accessible; only bounded headers were downloaded.

license.note: MIT is the distributed DeepSeek release license; its Qwen3-8B Base source declares Apache-2.0. Do not substitute the base license for the release declaration.

parameters_b.note: Retain the complete learned checkpoint count of 8,190,735,360 from the prior 399-tensor BF16 header census. Fresh pinned-index and configuration checks corroborate that evidence; no shards were downloaded again. Qwen’s 8B/8.2B labels remain nominal, not replacements for the precise total.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal 8B activated parameters, inferred from DeepSeek’s explicit post-training of Qwen3-8B Base and identical-Qwen3-8B architecture statement. Qwen3 report Tables 17/18 explicitly publish 8B activated; fresh configurations match every parameter-bearing dimension. Distillation transfers teacher outputs into the unchanged student architecture, with no pruning, expansion or new modality documented. This follows the developer’s nominal activation convention rather than equating active with the precise total or non-embedding count.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Qwen3 Transformer with grouped-query attention; tensor names and configuration show ordinary dense MLPs and no expert routing.

context_window.note: Released configuration and tokenizer both set 131072. This uses 4x YaRN from 32768 original/native positions, not a claim of 131072 native training length or a hosted API guarantee.

modalities.note: Causal language model with text tokenization and text chat serialization; checkpoint has no visual/audio encoder or decoder.

reasoning.note: Exact-model chain-of-thought distillation and reasoning evaluations support reasoning; template explicitly handles </think>. No claim of a Qwen enable_thinking switch.

tool_call.note: The exact template serializes tool messages, but exact-variant tool training/evaluation is not documented in the accessed primary evidence. Shared card and announcement tool claims concern full R1-0528. Neither false nor true is established; clear the unsupported baseline false.

description.value: Dense reasoning model obtained by post-training Qwen3-8B Base on chain-of-thought outputs from DeepSeek-R1-0528.
description.note: States the exact base, teacher and dense architecture without transferring full-R1 capabilities or benchmark claims.

patch.description: Dense reasoning model obtained by post-training Qwen3-8B Base on chain-of-thought outputs from DeepSeek-R1-0528.
patch.notes: Complete checkpoint: 8,190,735,360 learned parameters. Nominal 8B active is inferred from documented Qwen3-8B post-training lineage, identical architecture and Qwen’s activated-parameter tables. Qwen3 dense architecture; 131072 configured context uses 4x YaRN from 32768 native positions. DeepSeek release declares MIT; underlying Qwen3-8B Base declares Apache-2.0. Release day is unresolved between a May 28 dated announcement and May 29 checkpoint upload, so only May 2025 is asserted. Tool-call capability of this exact distillation remains unverified despite template support; full-R1 tool benchmarks do not establish it.
